findings.title: Hardcoded Secrets & Key Scanning
findings.description: Scanned codebase for hardcoded production keys, API secrets, and passphrases.
findings.mitigation: No hardcoded secrets found. KeySchedule derives keys dynamically via HKDF-SHA256.

findings.title: Cryptographic Randomness Audit
findings.description: Verified source of random salts and nonces across crypto engine.
findings.mitigation: Enforces OS kernel CSPRNG via secrets.token_bytes / os.urandom (128B salt, 96B nonce).

findings.title: RFC 5116 AEAD & RFC 5869 HKDF Compliance
findings.description: Audited KDR-CA-AEAD cipher structure and key expansion logic.
findings.mitigation: Encrypt-then-MAC workflow verified; sub-keys K_c, K_m, K_r isolated via HKDF.

findings.title: Timing Oracle Verification
findings.description: Audited authentication tag verification logic for variable-time comparison vulnerabilities.
findings.mitigation: Uses constant-time hmac.compare_digest for 100% of tag verifications.

findings.title: Chosen-Ciphertext Attack & Tamper Rejection
findings.description: Tested decryption behavior on 6 tampered package scenarios (bit-flips, salt/nonce corruption, tag truncation).
findings.mitigation: 100% rejection rate verified; decrypt_bytes aborts with AuthenticationError before decryption.

findings.title: Nonce Freshness & Replay Attack Defense
findings.description: Evaluated replay attack prevention and nonce collision bounds.
findings.mitigation: 96-bit CSPRNG unique nonces bound to HMAC tag guarantee zero replay exposure (Birthday bound <= 2^-97).
